task_production_rates._example: BINARY TASK - Single rate, all tiers identical

defect_tolerance.QT2: Visible dust acceptable if not affecting adhesion
defect_tolerance.QT3: No visible dust on surfaces to be painted
defect_tolerance.QT4: No visible dust on surfaces to be painted
defect_tolerance.QT5: No visible dust on surfaces to be painted

task_production_rates.notes: Binary task. Surface is dust-free or it is not. Same standard all tiers.

task_production_rates._example: QT-CONDITIONAL TASK - Only appears in QT4/QT5

defect_tolerance.QT4: Mark holidays >1 inch, runs, sags for touch-up
defect_tolerance.QT5: Mark all visible holidays, runs, sags, nibs for touch-up

task_production_rates.notes: Conditional task. QT2/QT3 rely on painter self-inspection during application.

task_production_rates._example: QT-SCALED TASK - All tiers, rate varies

defect_tolerance.QT2: Visible wobble acceptable if coverage complete
defect_tolerance.QT3: Reasonably straight line, minor wobble acceptable at distance
defect_tolerance.QT4: Clean line, no visible wobble at 3 feet
defect_tolerance.QT5: Crisp line, no visible wobble at arm's length

task_production_rates.notes: Scaled task. Higher QT = slower pace, tighter tolerance.
